capabilities: Sort, reorder, and group bookmarks in a dedicated panel
Select and move or remove multiple bookmarks at once
Filter core Search results by bookmarked files
Import bookmarks from core Bookmarks or a JSON file and export them back
Remove duplicate and broken bookmarks and generate a bookmarks note
extras: Manual installation only (download release files); the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the Search filter and file explorer marker attach to Obsidian's UI internals and may break across versions.
intentEvidence: An expanded version of the Bookmarks. — moving, sorting, search filtering, and more.
problem: The core Bookmarks panel lacks sorting, bulk actions, filtering, and ways to import, export, or clean up bookmark data.

relations.evidence: Import from core Bookmarks — reads the core Bookmarks plugin

summary: Expanded bookmarks panel that adds sorting, multi-select, search filters, import/export, and cleanup tools on top of core Bookmarks.
